title: v0.4.0 release quality
desiredOutcome: A stranger can trust and adopt the plugin: CI proves every guard on two platforms, docs are runnable and warn about global hooks, policies (SECURITY/CONTRIBUTING/CHANGELOG) exist, hooks speak the canonical protocol, and the repo dogfoods its own manifest.
summary: Six content commits + this manifest + the release commit, tagged v0.4.0. CI runs the full battery on ubuntu and windows; this file is itself a CI fixture.

tasks.title: Canonical JSON permissionDecision deny for blocking guards
tasks.description: Replace the deprecated exit-2 + stderr blocking channel (indistinguishable from a hook crash) with hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision deny + reason on stdout, exit 0. Decision cores untouched.

add: each selftest asserts the deny payload shape

outcome.technical: _deny_payload() helper per guard; 133 selftest cases total.
outcome.descriptive: Blocks are now explicit protocol, not an ambiguous exit code.

tasks.title: CHANGELOG backfill + SECURITY threat model + CONTRIBUTING
tasks.description: Keep-a-Changelog 0.1.0-0.4.0 incl. the v0.2.0 tag/main mismatch note (fixed forward, tags never moved); guardrails-not-jails threat model with per-hook fail-mode table and seven accepted bypass classes; dev setup, test matrix, one-commit release rule, commands-vs-skills NO-GO decision record.

outcome.descriptive: The policy envelope a team needs before trusting an enforcement plugin.

tasks.title: Root README + plugin README overhaul
tasks.description: Repo landing page (GitHub showed the internal build guide); plugin README gains Requirements, runnable snippets (no more unresolvable <plugin> placeholder), the 'installing arms global hooks' warning with scoping/disable/uninstall, repos-without-tests guidance, and a one-session-per-clone note.

outcome.technical: Full rewrite of plugins/audit/README.md; new root README.md.
outcome.descriptive: Onboarding no longer requires reading the source.

tasks.title: PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE sync to 0.3/0.4 reality
tasks.description: Fix 'four guard hooks' (five), the stale claude-plugins rename note (marketplace is quality-gates), and every per-file section that predated the hardening; add launcher/CI/dogfood to the tree and verify sections.

outcome.technical: Guide again matches the code it documents.
outcome.descriptive: The self-sufficient build guide is true again.

tasks.title: CI: selftests + validators on ubuntu/windows
tasks.description: Three jobs: six selftest suites + launcher checks (interpreter resolution, fail-loud ask JSON, canonical deny JSON) on both OSes; the plugin's own validator + ajv over starter and this manifest; claude plugin validate for marketplace + plugin.

add: windows leg proves the python3->python->py fallback

outcome.technical: All steps simulated locally before commit.
outcome.descriptive: A hook regression can no longer ship silently.

tasks.title: Plugin metadata: repository, category, tags, strict
tasks.description: Add the professional-listing fields claude plugin validate and marketplaces surface.

outcome.technical: claude plugin validate passes for both manifests.

tasks.title: Dogfood manifest: this roadmap as an audit manifest
tasks.description: Write the repo's own roadmap (P1 shipped, P2 this release, P3 planned) as a manifest the plugin's validator + ajv verify in CI — a permanent integration fixture, a real-world example, and a reciprocal BUG-1<->P1.7 link exercising the new validator checks.
